comment: Every third-party file that the web vault ships from web/vendor, with the hash of the file as it is in this repository and the licence that it comes with. The build refuses a file whose hash is not the one listed here, and a file in web/vendor that is not listed. A change to a vendored file is a change to this list, with its notice in notices-extra.json.

files.name: qrcodegen
files.derivation: tsc 7.0.2 --target ES2022 --module esnext --strict, then one added line: export default qrcodegen;
